identity.name: Gables Estates
identity.notes: Guard-gated, ultra-exclusive waterfront community in Coral Gables developed in the early 1960s by ALCOA founder Arthur Vining Davis. Comprises 192 single-family lots (~179 residences), 166 of them waterfront, on 200+ acres of Biscayne Bay shoreline with sea-walled, deep-water canals and bridge-free access for mega-yachts (entry price reported $10M+). Purchase requires approval by Gables Estates Club, Inc. with resident sponsorship and a non-refundable six-figure application fee. Widely described as one of the most expensive residential neighborhoods in the U.S.

fees.note: Reported annual dues of ~$7,500 covering security and common area maintenance; exact current figures not publicly confirmed on official sources. Transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments unavailable in public sources. Reported/secondhand figure. Retrieved: 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z. Confidence: 0.55 (unconfirmed reported figure).

Non-refundable one-time membership application fee required prior to purchase: ~$100,000 for U.S. residents / ~$105,000 for foreign nationals; membership in Gables Estates Club, Inc. is a prerequisite to purchasing property, with sponsorship from existing residents. Corroborated by gablesestatesfl.com as a 'non-refundable six-figure application fee'. Retrieved: 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z. Confidence: 0.6 (reported, not officially confirmed).

Current HOA fee for homes in Gables Estates Club; includes common area maintenance, grounds maintenance, and security. Period (monthly/annual) not specified on page; varies by community/home. Check individual listings for exact fees.

HOA/association fee covers 24-hour security, common area landscaping, maintenance of common areas, and salaries for administrators and handymen. Purchasers must also join the Gables Estates Club, which requires a non-refundable application fee of $100,000 ($105,000 for foreign applicants). Listed here as an annual HOA fee; the one-time club application fee is captured separately below. Retrieved: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.9
Non-refundable application fee to become a member of the Gables Estates Club (required upon buying a home); $105,000 if the applicant is a foreigner. Retrieved: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.9

Non-refundable application fee to join Gables Estates Club, Inc. (required to purchase a property); application must be returned by appointment to the Club Administrator with two sponsors, banking references, and letters of recommendation. Retrieved from page content 2026-02-10.
Non-refundable Club application fee for foreign nationals (vs. $100,000 for others). Retrieved from page content 2026-02-10.

amenities.detail: Guard-gated secure community with 24/7 guard security; membership approval required for all property purchases. Retrieved: 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z. Confidence: 0.8 (stated across multiple sources).

200+ acres of Biscayne Bay shoreline; sea-walled canals with deep water, wide enough for large-yacht turns; bridge-free (no fixed bridges) direct access to Biscayne Bay, ~5 min from private dock to open bay; 166 of 192 lots directly on water. Retrieved: 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z. Confidence: 0.8 (stated in multiple sources).

Most waterfront homes include private deepwater docks; canals engineered for deep-water dockage, depths sufficient for mega-yacht berthing and vessels 100+ ft; bulkheads and riparian rights vary by lot. Retrieved: 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z. Confidence: 0.6 (marketing source).

Mandatory club membership as prerequisite to purchase; association manages membership approvals, enforces covenants (ARB approval for exterior modifications, paint, renovations, landscape changes), and oversees common area maintenance and security. Note: no clubhouse or pool facilities detailed in public sources — amenities focus on security and waterfront access. Retrieved: 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z. Confidence: 0.7. Retrieved: 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z. Confidence: 0.7.

Exclusive club; membership is required once you buy a Gables Estates home. Non-refundable application fee of $100,000 ($105,000 for foreign applicants). Retrieved: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.9

Armed G4S guards at both entrances and exits; they stop and check every vehicle/person entering and monitor every vehicle exiting. 24-hour patrol cars do constant surveillance on each street. Many G4S officers have served 10+ years (some up to 23). Retrieved: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.9
Association boat patrols guard members' yachts and watercraft at their docks and watch over backyards. Retrieved: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.9

Numerous cameras watch entrances, exits, streets, and waterways, monitored 24/7 by G4S officers; includes FLIR night vision cameras and beam detectors; recordings are kept. Retrieved: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.9

Located along Biscayne Bay with bayfront lots and unobstructed views over open water; non-bay homes sit on inlets or canals a short distance from the open ocean (no bridges). Retrieved: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.9
HOA fee covers common area landscaping and maintenance of common areas, plus administrators and handymen. Retrieved: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.8
On premises tennis courts available to Leucadendra club members only. Retrieved from page content 2026-02-10.

24-hour guard gated security by water and land; 24-hour armed guards provided by G4S at both entrances and exits; G4S officers stop and monitor all entering vehicles and persons. Retrieved from page content 2026-02-10.
Only community in South Dade to offer one-acre lots, allowing private dockage of oversized mega yachts and sport boats; each property has no bridges to bay. Retrieved from page content 2026-02-10.
Cameras placed throughout the community featuring night vision and beam detectors. Retrieved from page content 2026-02-10.

Coral Gables Police Department patrol cars and boat patrols constantly surveil each street and waterway, safeguarding yachts, watercrafts, and backyards 24 hours a day. Retrieved from page content 2026-02-10.

Gables Estates Club, Inc. — exclusive club of which all residents are required to be members as a prerequisite to purchasing a property; applications available at the Club office. Retrieved from page content 2026-02-10.

Strictly controlled, guard-gated enclave with monitored vehicle entry; access limited to residents, pre-approved guests, household staff, and vetted contractors; gate structure eliminates through-traffic. Active oversight and private security in addition to controlled access. No public shoreline access or pedestrian flow beyond residents and approved visitors. (Confidence 0.95, retrieved 2026-02-05T12:00:00Z.)
Deep-water, seawalled canals with bridge-free ocean access; canal design and deep-water frontage built for large yachts. (Confidence 0.9, retrieved 2026-02-05T12:00:00Z.)

Oversized waterfront parcels (lots frequently ~1/2 acre+, frontage ~100 to 200+ linear feet) allow large dock installations, secondary structures, and expansive pools. (Confidence 0.85, retrieved 2026-02-05T12:00:00Z.)
